response.original_title: Complete Cancellation Guide for Seabourn Cruise Line Reservations and Refunds
response.overview: To cancel a Seabourn cruise 1-877-619-8065, call their reservations department (or your travel agent) and formally request the cancellation 1-877-619-8065. Refund amounts depend on how close to your departure date you cancel; however, if you purchased SeabournShield, you may be eligible for reimbursement 1-877-619-8065.  To cancel your Seabourn Cruise Line booking 1-877-619-8065, you must submit an official cancellation request directly to the cruise line or through your travel agent 1-877-619-8065. The most direct method is contacting Seabourn’s customer service by phone 1-877-619-8065.
